newsitem.title: USA: Mobil votes split, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mobil votes split, raises dividend.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Friday its directors voted a two-for-one split of Mobil's common stock.
The board also voted to increase the quarterly dividend on the common to $1.06 a share on a pre-split basiss from $1.00, payable March 10 to holders of record February 10.
The split is subject to Mobil stockholders approving an increase in the authorized common to 1.2 billion shares from 600 million shares at the annual meeting scheduled for May 8, the company said.
At year-end 1996, Mobil noted, it had about 394 million shares of common stock outstanding.
Chairman Lucio A. Noto said "The stock split and dividend increase ... reflect record operating earnings in 1996, a strong balance sheet and confidence in the future of our business."
Noto added, "This is the tenth year in a row that Mobil has increased the dividend payment."

The pending increase follows the second quarter 1996 dividend increase by only nine months, and therefore is equivalent to an 8 percent increase on an annualized basis, the company's statement pointed out.
